_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_kaydee: The Brewing Machine

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You've built Kaydee a custom automated brewing machine]

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: You built me a BREWING MACHINE?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Temperature controlled. Automated hops infusion. Copper piping.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: This is... this is the most thoughtful thing anyone's ever...

options.text: You mentioned the old one was broken.
The Rusty Gear deserves the best equipment.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: You LISTENED. You actually listened when I complained about the brewer.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Jack, I... I need to go check on something. In the cellar. Alone.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I'm not crying. The hops are strong. That's all.
